items.title: Bill Dobbins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... talking to Professor Bill Dobbins. [INTERVIEWEE] Well thanks for inviting me, Monk.

ctx.x: Bill was interviewed in Rochester, New York on January 11, 2012, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am off camera, but I’m happy to be in Rochester, New York at the Eastman School of Music talking to Professor Bill Dobbins. Thanks for joining me.
Well thanks for inviting me, Monk.
